SUPERSEDES.REASON: V2 independent interop review found incomplete root component schemas and nondeterministic external-candidate disposition.

SNAPSHOT_BINDING.RULE: Every enumerated path/blob/reference and every locator resolution MUST be evaluated against one exact pinned control commit/tree. No mixed-snapshot rows are valid.

PATH_NORMALIZATION.RULE: Repository paths use '/' separators, NFC, no leading '/', no trailing '/', no empty segment, no '.' or '..' segment.

JSON.FINDING_ID: top-level /FINDING_ID; exactly one JSON member by JSON parser semantics; non-empty NFC string or null
JSON.TYPE_RAW: top-level /TYPE as exact string or null
JSON.SEVERITY_RAW: top-level /SEVERITY as exact string or null
JSON.STATUS_RAW: top-level /STATUS as exact string or null
JSON.FINDING_REF: top-level /FINDING_REF as exact string or null

MARKDOWN.REGION: Leading metadata lines before the first blank line only.
MARKDOWN.FINDING_ID: FINDING_ID exactly once and non-empty NFC string or null
MARKDOWN.TYPE_RAW: TYPE exact metadata value or null
MARKDOWN.SEVERITY_RAW: SEVERITY exact metadata value or null
MARKDOWN.STATUS_RAW: STATUS exact metadata value or null
MARKDOWN.FINDING_REF: FINDING_REF exact metadata value or null

RAW_EXTRACTION.STRING_VALIDITY: Non-null authority-bearing strings MUST equal NFC(value) and MUST have no leading/trailing Unicode whitespace; otherwise parse/classification validity fails closed.

FIELD_TYPES.parsed_finding_id: non-empty normalized FINDING_ID string or null

RULES: Every tracked blob directly under or recursively below PRIMARY_ROOT appears exactly once.
Basename in PRIMARY_INFRA_BASENAMES -> NON_FINDING_INFRA and parsed_finding_id=null.
Supported .json/.md that parses and has exactly one valid FINDING_ID whose basename stem equals FINDING_ID -> FINDING_DEFINITION.
Supported .json/.md with parse failure, invalid FINDING_ID, duplicate markdown metadata key, or basename mismatch -> PARSE_ERROR.

FIELD_TYPES.parsed_finding_id: non-empty normalized FINDING_ID string or null
FIELD_TYPES.parsed_finding_ref: non-empty normalized FINDING_ID string or null
FIELD_TYPES.matched_locator_finding_id: non-empty normalized FINDING_ID string or null

DISPOSITION_RULES: Parse candidate with RAW_EXTRACTION; parse failure -> PARSE_ERROR.
If both parsed_finding_id and parsed_finding_ref are non-null -> AMBIGUOUS_ID_AND_REF.
If parsed_finding_id is non-null: basename_stem MUST equal parsed_finding_id. If not -> BASENAME_ID_MISMATCH.
If parsed_finding_id is non-null and exact path+ID matches one V3 external locator -> LOCATED_EXTERNAL_FINDING_DEFINITION.
If parsed_finding_id is non-null and no exact V3 locator matches -> MISPLACED_UNLOCATED_FINDING_DEFINITION.

If parsed_finding_id is null and parsed_finding_ref is non-null -> VALID_EXTERNAL_REFERENCE_ARTIFACT only when that referenced ID resolves exactly once in the eventual normalized finding rows; otherwise UNRESOLVED_REFERENCE_ARTIFACT.
If both parsed_finding_id and parsed_finding_ref are null -> UNSUPPORTED_EXTERNAL_CANDIDATE.
Only LOCATED_EXTERNAL_FINDING_DEFINITION and VALID_EXTERNAL_REFERENCE_ARTIFACT are nonblocking dispositions. Every other disposition blocks completeness.

AUTHORITY_REFERENCE_POINTER_REGISTRY.ARRAY_WILDCARD: * means every array element in index order

FIELD_TYPES.json_pointer: non-empty NFC JSON pointer from active registry

AUTHORITY_REFERENCE_ROW_SCHEMA.SORT: authority_path UTF-8, json_pointer UTF-8, array_index with null before integers, finding_id UTF-8

FIELD_TYPES.AUTHORITY_REFERENCE_PATHS: sorted unique array of normalized repository paths

MATERIALIZATION_RULES: Emit one row for each PRIMARY FINDING_DEFINITION and each LOCATED_EXTERNAL_FINDING_DEFINITION.
Same FINDING_ID at distinct definition paths -> DUPLICATE_FINDING_ID_CONFLICT and completeness fails.
Same definition path discovered more than once -> one row only, union authority-reference paths then sort unique.
RAW_FIELD_CONFLICT=true whenever multiple authoritative parsers/locations for the same exact definition disagree on TYPE_RAW, SEVERITY_RAW or STATUS_RAW; conflict blocks completeness.
NORMALIZED_FINDING_ROW_SCHEMA.SORT: FINDING_ID UTF-8 bytes, then DEFINITION_PATH UTF-8 bytes

VALIDATION_SUMMARY_SCHEMA.EXACT_COMPLETE_RULE: complete=true iff primary_blob_count==primary_accounted_count, primary_parse_error_count==0, primary_unsupported_count==0, external_candidate_count==external_nonblocking_count, external_blocking_count==0, unresolved_authority_reference_count==0, duplicate_finding_id_count==0, raw_field_conflict_count==0, and every authority reference resolves exactly once.

FIELD_TYPES.contract_blob_sha: lowercase 40-hex Git blob SHA of this exact V3 contract
FIELD_TYPES.external_locator_blob_sha: lowercase 40-hex Git blob SHA of accepted V3 locator contract

COMPLETE_FINDING_MANIFEST_ROOT_HASH.HASH_ACCEPTANCE_GATE: validation_summary.complete MUST be true before the hash may be accepted as an activation denominator.

PROJECTION_ADAPTER_EXPORT.ADAPTER_GATE: Universe validation_summary.complete=true, RAW_FIELD_CONFLICT=false, and all mapped fields pass their exact V3 types. No field derivation from free text or aliases is permitted.

COMPLETENESS_REQUIRES: All row schemas and exact disposition rules pass.
Every authority-reference pointer is evaluated on the same pinned tree and resolves exactly once.
All external locator entries re-resolve and validate at the pinned snapshot.
Validation summary exact complete rule evaluates true.
Independent generator recomputes identical RFC8785/JCS root bytes and SHA-256.
